en: Find the Light Ruins

When you meet King Balgert, he tells you to
find the Light Ruins and hands you a
compass.
And so you set out for the Konnu Plains Ruins.
Molder: Find the Light Ruins

Haven't you already done this one? Your
adventure's only just getting started.
Good luck!
Gathering of Rulers

Following King Balgert's suggestion,
you head for the Temple of Rafa.
Molder: Gathering of Rulers

So, wasn't that fun? With that many exalted
people in one place, it was quite a sight,
wasn't it? You don't get to see that every
day, so you'd better thank big sis here,
okay?
Hemaid Red Stone

You have found the Lightstair Ruins, but its
light is already gone. To restore it, you
must place the Three Phantom Stones
in the three altars.
Molder: Hemaid Red Stone

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to King Balgert.
Green Plakio

You have found the Lightstair Ruins, but its
light is already gone. To restore it, you
must place the Three Phantom Stones
in the three altars.
Molder: Green Plakio

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to King Balgert.
Blue Menon

You have found the Lightstair Ruins, but its
light is already gone. To restore it, you
must place the Three Phantom Stones
in the three altars.
Molder: Blue Menon

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to King Balgert.
Selcoa Paint

Empress Rianna is building a magic airship to
fly straight into the Palace of the Sun and
take it back from the Kin of Darkness. But
the work is proving very hard, and you are
ordered to get the 'Selcoa Paint' needed to
coat the hull.
Molder: Selcoa Paint

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to Her Majesty Rianna.
Celestial Readings

To keep the magic airship out of unforeseen
trouble, the movements of the heavens must
be predicted. You are ordered to report
the 'Celestial Readings'.
Molder: Celestial Readings

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to Her Majesty Rianna.
Wing Soul

The last material needed to fly the magic
airship: the 'Wing Soul'. Said to be a
shining wing that gained a soul, it is also
called the wings of all beings. Empress
Rianna has tried everything but has yet to
find it. You are ordered to seek it
your own way.
Molder: Wing Soul

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to Her Majesty Rianna.
Old Man's Plans

Ogre Bay, led by King Fulgrant, has a bold
plan: shoot down the Palace of the Sun with
a cannon. But the cannon design drawn by
the King's father, 'The Old Man's
Blueprints', has been lost. You are to find
it using the compass.
Molder: Old Man's Plans

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to King Fulgrant.
Cannon Tools

You found 'Old Man's Plans', but it
turns out the 'Cannon Tools' needed to build
the cannon were lost too.
Once again, you must search, this time for
the 'Cannon Tools'.
Molder: Cannon Tools

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to King Fulgrant.
Seasoned Snacks

With 'Old Man's Plans' and the
'Cannon Tools' in hand, only the building is
left. But King Fulgrant declares that the
cannon's debut must be a big festival, with
'Seasoned Snacks' to nibble on. And so
you must search yet again.
Molder: Seasoned Snacks

This one you'll just have to find on your
own. Don't worry, as long as you use the
compass, you should find it. Once you do,
report to King Fulgrant.
Save Perpeco Village

Perpeco Village in the Perpeco Forest is under
attack by monsters. You can't just leave it.
Hurry, adventurers!
Molder: Save Perpeco Village

There's a place called Perpeco Village in
Perpeco Forest, and it looks like monsters
are attacking it. Go help them out.
Chatty Sapling

A chatty sapling with plenty of demands about
where it will put down roots. Where could
there be a place that satisfies it?
Molder: Chatty Sapling

A sapling with a lot of demands, hm? Why not
just toss it? ...Kidding, kidding! Let's see,
isn't there a kid in Perpeco Village who's
good at growing plants? Why not ask them?
I Love Farming!

The sapling says it needs some wonderful
fertilizer in order to grow.
Where could you possibly get some,
and how?
Molder: I Love Farming!

The reading's come out, but I can't quite
make sense of it. It says: Wonderful
Turmeric, the girl of Perpeco Forest, and a
girl stuck fast, unable to move. Huh?
Attack on Lumisthenes

Lumisthenes has been attacked by an unknown
foe. Join forces with everyone and defend
the city!
Molder: Attack on Lumisthenes

This one's already settled, right? Thanks
for what you did back then.
Sun Prison Shrine

The far, far distant tale of certain fairies,
held within the Sun Prison Shrine.
And the one who tells it is...
Molder: Sun Prison Shrine

How do you read this? 'Sun... Prison...
Shrine'? Huh. Something this old, only a
being that's lived just as long would
understand it, I bet. And that one is high
up in the sky.
Retake the Sun Palace

Humans, elves, ogres, and... Bearing all of
their hopes, the adventurers have at last
reached the Palace of the Sun.
Can you save the land?
Molder: Retake the Palace of the Sun

Humans, elves, ogres... I'm leaving all
their hopes in your hands. Do your best,
okay?
Hail Great Adventurers

You have retaken the Palace of the Sun and
spared the land from collapse. Evil beings,
monsters, the scars of past tragedy: these
will never vanish, but your deeds were
beyond doubt. Hail the great
adventurers!
Molder: Hail the Great Adventurers

Thank you! Now the land is saved! I can't
thank you enough!
Truth of the Sun

King Balgert still seems concerned about the
Palace of the Sun. Once again you head for
the stage of the final battle,
the Palace of the Sun.
And there...
Molder: Truth of the Sun

It seems the Palace of the Sun's role isn't
over yet. It's a dangerous place, but go
back once more and search every corner.
Land of the Next Age

You passed through the door the librarian
led you to. Beyond it spread a land you had
never seen.
Molder: Land of the Next Age

I sense a mighty power somewhere other than
here. One, two... lots. It'll be a dangerous
battle, far worse than any so far. ...What?
Let me say something fortune-teller-ish for
once!
Bring a New Light

The Palace of the Sun, thought to be the
beginning and the end of everything.
But its role was not yet over. Yes, there
are still those who cannot let their
story end...
Molder: Bring a New Light

Somewhere far, far away from here, far, far
higher than the Palace of the Sun. It seems
you can head there from a land other than
this one... Sorry, that's all I can tell.
Makana Essence

"You'll cause trouble in the shop!" -- and
so you aren't allowed to form a mixed party
of Good and Evil. Just then, Mucha sets
you a challenge.
Molder: Makana Essence

Ahh, personalities that don't mesh... Nobody
wants brawls in the tavern, huh. All right!
With a mixed party of Good and Evil, go get
the Makana Essence and show off how well
you get along!
A Gift for a Late Wife

Old Zeppo the dragonewt asks you to gather
a Crystal Flower "for my late wife."
Molder: A Gift for a Late Wife

It's called a Crystal Flower, so it should
be near the Crystal Labyrinth's entrance.
Bringing his old lady her favorite flower...
what a good husband he is, huh?
Toner's Checkup

Since Gia is injured, you are more or less
forced to go with Toner to a health checkup
in her place.
Molder: Toner's Checkup

Why do skilled people always want to live
somewhere so remote? Go to the Leanmakana
Mountains and Toner can get the checkup. I
hope the results are good.
Life and Money

Word is that Hardy the Money-Grubber is
looking after a graveyard.
Why do something that earns no money?
Molder: Life and Money

That money-grubber caring about a nameless
cemetery that earns nothing? Weird, huh? But
go chase off those graveyard vandals right
away! Off to the Crotoa City Ruins, let's
go!
Fena's Thoughts

King Balgert is pushing Fena to train more
adventurers, but the Training Hall is
understaffed. You are asked to find someone
ideal for training the rookies. There seems
to be more on Fena's mind.
Molder: Fena's Thoughts

True, Abi would make a good practice
partner. Abi's in the Konnu Plains Ruins.
Oh, but it's no good unless you can use
summoning spells, okay?
How Utterly Exquisite!

He claims that prosperity shows most in
amusements and luxuries. Right or not, he
seems, in his own way, to be worried about
the state of the town.
Molder: How Utterly Exquisite!

Speaking of outlandish: Joker Land!
Actually, the souvenir shop in Joker Land
has a secret recipe.
Madulay's Request

Madulay, the artisan who builds the magic
airship, asks you to go and get whetstones
for the job.
Molder: Madulay's Request

They should be in the Rinos Sea Volcano, but
do you know the way? You can get there from
beneath Joker Land, but only after helping a
kid in trouble there. Also, it was two,
right? Medium and Fine Whetstone. Make sure
you bring back both!
The Midnight Hunter

Every night Shimerief sits in the watchtower
and will not budge. Asked why, she dodges
the question, but...
Molder: The Midnight Hunter

That old lady climbs the watchtower every
night and won't budge. Is something up? The
spot is under the Blue Cave, I hear... What
is she up to?
Forbidden Blue Rain

Toner is looking for Blue Rain. Blue Rain
seems to be very important to Toner.
Blue Rain is apparently 'something exciting.'
Blue Rain, Blue Rain,
exciting Blue Rain...
Molder: The Forbidden Blue Rain

Blue Rain? Huh...? That kid wants it? Wait,
isn't that kid... Well, it's not okay, but
fine. You can steal it from a guy called
Phantom. ...You could also steal some off
the Santorea Academy girls... but I don't
recommend it...
Plan: Hug Decoykins

Out of her obsessive devotion to Decoy,
she hits on the idea of setting a trap.
All for love's sake...
Molder: Operation Hug Decoykins

Oh, that one who's always running around?
For a weird thing like that, there's a
doctor in Ogre Bay who only makes weird
stuff, I hear. Try asking that doctor.
Don't Call Me Cute!

He surely never wished to look
the way he does.
That is why he hatches a plan.
Molder: Don't Call Me Cute!

Being cute is rough, huh. I'm jealous...
Nobody's called me cute lately... Oh, sorry.
Um, search Joker Land and you should find
where the Jokers keep their costumes.
Formless Treasure

Knowledge, however much you store, takes up
no space and can be carried anywhere. And
today, as ever, the old man passes it on.
Molder: Formless Treasure

Everyone's fed up with those thieves. It
hasn't been long since the theft, so you
should find them at the Crotoa City Ruins.
The Emera Program

Counselor Emera's healing program.
All who carry darkness in their hearts,
come along now.
Molder: The Emera Program

Have you met that girl Necrophilis yet? If
so, you're all set. Just go to Emera's place
in the Leanmakana Mountains at night.
An Outcast's Path

They should have shared the same lot, so why
did they turn out so different?
A thief and a girl. What was it that set
the two apart?
Learning the answer, what will
the thief think?
Molder: An Outcast's Path

A Soleil Stone: a stone for praying for
someone's safety and happiness. But it's
very rare and hard to find. The mimics in
the Blue Cave are hoarding some, I think,
but mimics in numbers are tough.
Martial Arts Tourney

In the Martial Arts Building of Santorea
Academy, you can fight Professor Rombino!
Win it all, and something good
might happen.
Molder: Martial Arts Tournament

There's a martial arts tournament at the
Santorea Academy Martial Arts Building. Win
it, and something good might happen, maybe?
Magical Party

In the Magic Building of Santorea Academy,
you can fight Professor Nambino!
Win it all, and something good
might happen.
Molder: Magical Party

There's a Magical Party at the Santorea
Academy Magic Building. Win it, and
something good might happen, maybe?
What Makes a King

Ghosts have appeared, troubling the fairy
village. On the orders of Meem, the Fairy
King, you are to drive them out.
Molder: What Makes a King

The fairy village, huh. In a place like
that, it's easy to wander in by mistake.
It's a bit mean to them, but go tell them
they've come to the wrong place, okay?
LooKing foR SomeOne...

A woman of broken speech and a foul-mouthed
man. The pair ask you to help find someone.
Molder: I'm LooKing foR SomeOne...

A short girl with blue hair, huh. She seems
to be deep in the Crystal Labyrinth... but
that pair looking for her, are they all
right? They don't seem like ordinary folk...
Strange Box Garden

A strange box garden: set it up in 'a certain
place' and it activates, drawing you into the
little garden for all kinds of exploring.
Now, where might 'a certain place' be?
Molder: Strange Box Garden

That Box Garden: there's a spot northeast in
the Crotoa City Ruins where it can be set,
and placed there, its power awakens. That
box... something wonderful will come of it,
so take good care of it, okay?
Dice of Fate Jackpot

What is gambling? Numbers adding up, or
something decided by fate?
That eternal question is about to be settled
by the fortune-teller Natori.
Molder: Dice of Fate Jackpot

That's MY request! Ehh, you forgot? Geez, I
asked you, didn't I? You can synthesize it
if you have Mazurite and Millstone, okay?
Geezers' Wand

The Central Council, where many views are
gathered and debated. Its Council Chair is
Wattner.
Lately he seems rather worn out.

Endless, fruitless council sessions are hard
on old bones. We seek the Geezers' Wand,
said to restore vigor to the elderly.

Eh, someone asked you for the Geezers' Wand?
Ehh... I don't wanna tell... Mmm, the
monsters in the fairy village have one, I
hear, so you should get it there...
A Clouded Heart

Driven by ambition and a thirst for knowledge,
she carries on her research. And her dislike
of adventurers had its reasons.

Not urgent, merely handy: we need a Vision
Crystal for our observing device. If found,
bring it to the Stargazing Lighthouse,
Star Capital Lumisthenes.

She's a bit uptight, but she's honest and a
good girl, so don't hate her, okay? Bring
her the Vision Crystal from the Crystal
Labyrinth and she'll rethink a lot. But
watch out for the Doppelganger.
The Aging Songstress

'Let song speak, let verse sing.' A singer
should speak through song, yet from her lips
come only words of longing for the old days.
What is on the aging songstress's mind?

Seeking something to restore strength to an
old, failing throat. That is a little too
convenient a wish, I suppose...

I used to hear her sing whenever I went to
Teridon. Search the Giaf Dunes and you
should find a cactus, so take it to her.
Still, singers sure have it rough too, huh.
Yo! Bunch of Softies!

She has values of her own. That blatant lie
may have some purpose behind it.

wanted: sumbody who will lend me munny.
zonette

Is she straightforward, or just twisted? Who
knows. But try to believe what she says as
much as you can, okay?
Love's Smuggling Run

A man living out 'love saves the world'
to the letter. He plotted to smuggle love.

To Her Majesty the Empress, with love.
Seeking adventurers to deliver a confidential
parcel. -- Chief Barjeff

First you need to be able to get an audience
with Her Majesty Rianna, or you can't hand
over what you've got. But I've got a baaad
feeling about this...
Casino

Good day to you,
and welcome to MILL.GP.
Honored guest, might I interest you in a
game with me today?

MILL.GP. looks forward to your visit and
your challenge.

Beat the dealer at blackjack! It's the only
way! Think of it as avenging me, and wipe
the floor with them!!
Secret Service

The Love Jacuzzi has a special service of its
own for valued customers.
But for that, something is needed.

We're out of Stonemelt Water for guests and
I'm in a bind. If you have extra, please
share some. In return, I'll give you special
service at the shop!

A special service~? You're thinking
something naughty, aren't you? Stonemelt
Water? Buy it at a shop or pick it up in
dungeons and you'll have enough in no time,
won't you?
Put Something On!!

Do different races have different senses of
shame? Nora doesn't mind at all, but
her coworker Yuna fusses over Nora's
underwear.

My coworker... um... well... she won't wear
any... panties... and it's a problem. Her
bottom is extra big, so I'm looking for
big panties.

Panties that big probably aren't sold in
stores... but handmade ones might exist. Why
not visit the Sewing Club at Santorea
Academy?
Tarrit's Close Call!

Her ordeals never end.
Or are the ordeals really falling on you,
the ones mixed up with her...?
Molder: Tarrit's Close Call!

Ummm... I see signs of hardship...
Specifically, the Konnu Plains Ruins, B2F.
That noisy girl is in trouble, it seems.
Well, I know it'll be rough, but... hang in
there~.
Mandelgius's Trial 1

Mandelgius orders you to bring back an Azure
Fish, calling it training to become heroes.
Molder: Mandelgius's Trial 1

So it's Professor Mandelgius, Santorea
Academy's famous special lecturer. You can
catch Azure Fish in the Blue Cave at night,
but there are dangerous fish too, so be
careful, okay?
Mandelgius's Trial 2

Mandelgius orders you to bring back the
Proof of Endurance, calling it training to
become heroes.
Molder: Mandelgius's Trial 2

The Rinos Sea Volcano, huh? Just the place
that intense one would name. The Proof of
Endurance is to the south, but be sure to
use Sosareo or something to get there, okay?
Mandelgius's Trial 3

Mandelgius orders you to bring the Evil
Magistrate to justice, calling it training
to become heroes.
Molder: Mandelgius's Trial 3

An even greater evil pulling the strings
behind every misdeed... sounds fake. Isn't
that just talk to fit the mood... oh, there
really is one. ...Um, it's in Miasuna's
Castle Keep.
Mandelgius's Trial 4

Mandelgius orders you to defeat the Tiger
Centaur, calling it training to become heroes.
Molder: Mandelgius's Trial 4

This time it's for real: Tiger Centaur III
is deep in the Giaf Dunes. But it's a tough
foe, so be careful, okay? Mandelgius... just
who is that, I wonder...
Can't Get Out~

Can people never resist temptation?
The realization always comes too late.
Her cries for help fade away into the
forest.
Molder: Can't Get Out~

I see a girl named Tarrit stuck in the Konnu
Plains Ruins... Besides pulling, kicking
might change something... but I don't think
you should do that to a girl.
Crumbling Stone Tablet

A teacher and scholar at Santorea Academy
asks you to survey some ruins.
Molder: Crumbling Stone Tablet

Just go to the basement of the Konnu Plains
Ruins on a rainy day and examine the stone
tablet, that's all. Even that is a real help
to a scholar who's always cooped up.
Old School Ghost Story

It's Santorea Academy's welcome party for
new students, in the old school building~!
Molder: Old School Ghost Story

A test of courage? How nostalgic! I did one
too. Clinging to the one I liked with a
'Kyaa!'... ahem. Talk to the Santorea
Academy kid, then go to the haunted mansion,
leave a mark and come back to report. No
running away if you get scared!
Don't Pick on Me

Paralyzed, put to sleep, sometimes even
petrified and then swallowed by a fissure:
such is his lot, poor unlucky soul.
And now, for some reason, he's digging a
hole...?
Molder: Don't Pick on Me

So the Picnicker wants a Garden Keeper.
You're always paralyzing it, putting it to
sleep, petrifying it... You put it through
so much, so why not help it out for once?
Something good might come of it, like new
places to go!
Ogre Bay Cleanup Op.

They say if you find one, there are thirty
more around... You know. THOSE.
Molder: Operation Ogre Bay Cleanup

Ultimate... ugh, geez! I hate even saying
the name! Go wipe out every last one!!
The Ruler's Amusement

Know too much of everything, and boredom
sets in. To kill time, the ruler has chosen
you.
Molder: The Ruler's Amusement

...Hmm, well, once you've done something
like going around saving the world, maybe go
tell them about that? ...I mean, I can't see
a thing! Who is that!? What on earth are
they!?
